raw.details:
Overview

Welcome to Fetch-A-Thon 3.0, a national-level AI Agent hackathon bringing together students, developers, innovators, startup enthusiasts, and AI enthusiasts from across India to explore the exciting world of Agentic AI and build intelligent, real-world AI Agent solutions.

Whether you're an experienced developer or just beginning your AI journey, this is your chance to LEARN. BUILD. COLLABORATE. INNOVATE.

The challenge is real. The possibilities are limitless. Are you ready?

WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/FAgowp2Sd4PApaXr6jqQyL

What Is Fetch-A-Thon 3.0?

  • Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 is a hands-on national AI Agent challenge where participants explore how intelligent agents can understand user intent, interact with tools and services, coordinate with other agents, and perform meaningful tasks.
  • Get introduced to ASI and Agentverse, explore the possibilities of Agentic AI, and put your skills to the test by developing practical AI Agent solutions that address real-world problems.
  • Don't just build another chatbot. Think bigger. Build something that can actually DO something.

What Awaits You?

Explore AI Agents & Agentic AI

Discover how AI is evolving beyond traditional chatbots into intelligent systems capable of reasoning, interacting with tools, coordinating workflows, and taking action.

Build with ASI & Agentverse

Explore the ASI ecosystem and get hands-on with technologies that help you understand and build AI Agent-based solutions.

Solve a Real-World Challenge

Put your creativity and technical skills to work. Identify a meaningful problem, develop your approach, and transform your idea into a functional AI Agent.

Learn by Building

Design, develop, test, and refine your solution with your team. Experiment, iterate, troubleshoot, and turn your concepts into working prototypes.

Learn from Mentors

Get guidance, insights, and feedback to help you strengthen your ideas and improve your project throughout the building process.

Who Should Participate?

  • College student or aspiring developer
  • Software developer or engineer
  • AI/ML enthusiast
  • AI Agent builder
  • Startup founder or aspiring entrepreneur
  • Open-source contributor
  • Curious innovator excited about Agentic AI

No need to be an AI expert to get started! Bring your curiosity, creativity, willingness to learn, and passion for solving problems. The goal is to learn by building and push the boundaries of what you can create.

What Can You Build?

Think beyond conventional applications. Imagine AI Agents that can:

  • Automate repetitive tasks and workflows.
  • Help people make smarter, more informed decisions.
  • Interact with tools, APIs, and digital services.
  • Coordinate multiple tasks to solve complex problems.
  • Deliver innovative solutions to everyday challenges.

These are just starting points. Your imagination sets the direction. Your skills bring the idea to life.

Project Submission & Results

  • Participants will develop their AI Agent solutions and submit their projects for evaluation.
  • Final Results Announcement: 28 October 2026

Build something meaningful, demonstrate what your solution can do, and show the world what's possible with Agentic AI!

Fetch-A-Thon 3.0

Learn. Build. Collaborate. Create.

The future isn't just intelligent. It's agentic. Let's build it together.
